dataset: EduGage public release; four previously inspected lectures
reuse_disclosure: The four lecture sources and EEG timing adapters were inspected in the separate existing neuroscience project. Behavioral endpoints are newly proposed here. This is not an untouched external test set.
crossed_cells: Report both held-out topic-family folds crossed with all four held-out participant groups; complete participant histories and lesson versions stay together. Unsupported cells remain unsupported.

secondary_endpoint.name: post-quiz correctness conditional on pre-quiz score
secondary_endpoint.resolution: supported question or assessment pairing only
secondary_endpoint.prerequisite: verified key and valid pre/post pairing

primary_comparison: all blocks versus content only, across every supported predetermined cell
tribe_specific_control: Dimension-matched features from TRIBE's underlying content encoders must be included before attributing benefit to brain alignment.
transform_scope: Fit scaling, PCA (at most 16 dimensions per representation block), EEG encoder, feature selection and regularization inside each training scope only.
missingness_policy: Keep every scheduled cell. Exclude only unqualified media or unsupported labels and report the exclusion. Never silently substitute a lecture, participant or timestamp.
leakage_checks: no overlapping EEG windows across folds
no answer keys in student context
claim_gate: A neuroscience benefit claim requires a supported primary comparison, uncertainty across people and lessons, and a dimension-matched content control. Broad generalization requires further human validation.
execution_gate: Do not run until the external research volume is mounted with verified identity, both disks have at least 12 GiB free, and the separate audit records probe semantics, keys, pairings, prior label access, media mappings and missing viewings.
